title: Cognitive Security and the Social Implications of Generative AI
venue: Symposium on Law & AI · Stanford Law School
description: Joint talk with Aneesh Pappu on the social implications of training and using generative AI to influence human behavior — from product ads and political persuasion to engagement nudges. We discussed two of our recent projects: (1) what can go wrong (joint work with James Zou) and (2) where this is all headed (joint work with Shiye Su, Aneesh Pappu, Peggy Yin, Julie Heng, Eric Heng, Ryan Wang, Andreas Haupt, and James Zou). Thanks to Jasper Burns for the invitation.
